name: Render Motion Graphics (Remotion)
description: Renders motion graphics overlays (upper third, accent shapes, progress bar) to per-segment ProRes 4444 videos with alpha using Remotion. Takes the enhancement spec from step 4.03 and creative direction for styling, then produces one overlay per spine block.

inputs.name: audio_spine
inputs.description: Timed audio spine for duration and block structure

inputs.name: creative_direction
inputs.description: Creative direction for accent colors, title text, style choices

inputs.name: enhancement_spec
inputs.description: VFX plan from step 4.03 with effect entries

outputs.name: motion_graphics_overlay
outputs.description: Per-segment overlay paths and metadata for Resolve placement

preconditions: Remotion project is set up in remotion-subtitles/
postconditions: 'motion_graphics_overlay' is written to state with segment overlay paths
